threads.body:
The script now calls `gh issue list/create/comment` when it decides to skip reruns. This script is also used by `.github/workflows/rerun-flaky-pr-jobs.yml`, which does not grant `issues: write`; in that workflow these new code paths will fail with a permissions error and cause the rerun workflow itself to fail.

Consider gating issue creation behind an explicit env var (set only by the daily workflow), or otherwise ensuring all workflows that use this script have the required `issues` permissions.
threads.hunk:
@@ -28,6 +28,7 @@ def main() -> None:
     rerun_attempts = run["run_attempt"] - 1
     if rerun_attempts >= max_rerun_attempts:
         print(f"Skipped {label}: already rerun {rerun_attempts} times.")
+        open_issue_if_missing(owner, repo, run)
         return

replies.body: Thanks, good catch. Addressed in b1a1d63f93 by gating workflow-failure issue creation behind `CREATE_WORKFLOW_FAILURE_ISSUE=true` and setting that env var only in `rerun-failed-daily-jobs.yml`. `rerun-flaky-pr-jobs.yml` does not opt in, so this path will not call `gh issue ...` there.
